quote: Next come Dhobis, the traditional owners of the Unao tahsil, Barhais, Faqirs, Humhars and Kahars, each caste numbering over 10,000 persons at the last census.
note: lower bound 'over 10,000'; Faqirs appear in a list of castes in the Hindu section and again among Musalmans (l.11730); not separable from Muslim faqirs
